facts.fact: Per Nielsen's The Gauge as reported on the page, broadcast held 21.2% of total U.S. TV viewing in January 2026.
facts.quote: In January 2026, broadcast held 21.2% of total U.S. TV viewing per Nielsen's The Gauge.

facts.fact: Per Nielsen's The Gauge as reported on the page, broadcast rose to 21.7% of total U.S. TV viewing in February 2026.
facts.quote: In February 2026, broadcast rose to 21.7%, lifted by Super Bowl LX and the Winter Olympics on NBC.

facts.fact: Per Nielsen's The Gauge as reported on the page, streaming held 47.0% of TV viewing in January 2026, a record.
facts.quote: January 2026: Broadcast 21.2%, Streaming 47.0% (record), Cable approximately 25-26%, Other the remainder
